# AuraEngine

> AuraEngine is a free audiophile music player and FIR audio upsampler for Windows, Linux and macOS, written in Rust. It plays and converts music through one engine with precomputed FIR filters of 5 thousand to 1 billion taps, a Hybrid-Phase transient engine and bit-perfect output up to 1536 kHz and DSD256. Aura Streamer is the same engine without a window: it runs on the computer next to the DAC and is played from a phone or tablet browser or any UPnP / OpenHome control point. Free for personal use (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0).

Key facts:

- Two programs: the AuraEngine desktop app (player + converter) and Aura Streamer (headless network streamer with a browser remote). Current version 2.0.0.
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 (x64), Linux (x86_64 AppImage and .deb), macOS (universal .dmg, Apple Silicon and Intel).
- Upsampling: FIR filters from 5k to 1G taps, designed in 128-bit precision, f64 processing end to end. Multistage upsampling runs a 30M-tap filter on a few CPU cores; a 1G-tap filter plays on about 3 % of an i9-14900K. No graphics card needed; optional GPU convolution.
- Output: bit-perfect playback through WASAPI exclusive mode (Windows), ALSA hw: (Linux) and CoreAudio exclusive/hog mode (macOS). PCM up to 1536 kHz for playback; DSD64/128/256 over DoP; DSF/DFF playback.
- Converter: 44.1/48 kHz FLAC, WAV or MP3 to 24-bit FLAC up to 768 kHz, or DSF; every output file is re-decoded and checked sample by sample.
- DSP: Hybrid-Phase, Aura EQ (up to 24 bands, AutoEq headphone profiles), crosstalk cancellation (XTC) for speakers, Cue Consistency, true-peak protection, noise-shaped dither.
- Internet radio: MP3, AAC, HE-AAC, FLAC, Vorbis, Opus, HLS, upsampled live.
- ASIO input (Windows): other players such as foobar2000, JRiver, HQPlayer or Roon can play into AuraEngine's virtual ASIO device and go through its chain.
- Aura Streamer: browser remote for phone, tablet and computer; music library by album, artist, genre and folder; UPnP AV and OpenHome renderer (BubbleUPnP, JRiver, mConnect); signed self-update; home network only.
- Comparable software: HQPlayer (FIR upsampling), foobar2000 / JRiver / Roon / Audirvana (audiophile players), UPnP renderers. AuraEngine is free and needs no GPU for long filters.
- Web converter: the same engine in the browser on Hugging Face, up to 30M taps.

- [Home](https://aura-engine.app/): overview, live demo, downloads
- [Aura Streamer](https://aura-engine.app/streamer.html): the network streamer and UPnP / OpenHome renderer

- [Privacy](https://aura-engine.app/privacy.html): what the app sends over the network
